t0033-01.gloss: A passenger’s bottle is left behind despite a completed seat record.
t0033-01.rival_reading: A household move or field visit could explain the keys and bottle; the completed seat sheet does not prove an evacuation failed.

t0033-02.gloss: A family member links a lingering illness to a field bottle smell, while a return note denies a spill.
t0033-02.rival_reading: A cleanup crew may have used disinfectant after an emergency; the letter does not establish what liquid caused the irritation.
